newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates close down on dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates close down on dull trading.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed down on Monday in dull trading as spinners stayed away expecting a further fall in the prices, brokers said.
They said the spinners hoped the prices to fall with higher arrivals of cotton at ginneries from farms, brokers said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,125 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) compared to Sunday's 2,150.
The rates are likely to open lower on Tuesday, broker Nasim Usman at the Karachi Cotton Association said.
